''See also: [[Candle Bay Imperial Prison Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Candle Bay]] [[Imperial]] Prison, also referred to as the [[Candle Bay]] [[Imperial]] Prison and Reformative Facility, is a high-status correctional institution. The facility was destroyed when an [[Elderspawn]] tore it open, resulting in significant casualties among the staff and prisoners, as well as a mass escape of dangerous individuals including black [[Alchemists|alchemists]] and [[Soulbound]]. The destruction left the site in ruins, appearing as a pile of rubble near the harbor. The prison's history is linked to [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] the [[Curse-breaker]], who designed a prototype original [[Imperial]] Prison on [[Gray Island]]. This subterranean complex featured a labyrinthine structure with cells used to hold important guests of the [[Consultants' Guild|Consultant Guild]]. While some areas were described as cold and damp, they provided attentive care such as blankets and books to inmates. However, the facility was also characterized by some as a place of torture. Inmates at [[Candle Bay]] were identified by bright red one-piece uniforms. The reception area for the prison was noted for being cramped and uncomfortable, featuring small, unstable stools and a large desk. Following its destruction, reports indicated that the prison had since reopened.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Candle Bay]] [[Imperial]] Prison serves as the holding facility for [[Calder]]'s father. While the institution has previously turned [[Calder]] away, its small and cramped reception room is decorated almost entirely in white. Following [[Jerri]]'s entry into the prison, [[Calder]] finds himself positioned on the rocks located beneath the structure. Ultimately, the facility is torn open by the [[Elderspawn]].}}
